theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_covector_first_hit_selection
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (b : ℕ → Covector (Euclid P) n), (∀ k, MeasurableSet (A k)) → ∃ g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n, StronglyMeasurable g ∧ ∀ x, (g x = 0 ∧ ∀ k, x ∉ A k) ∨ ∃ k, x ∈ A k ∧ g x = b k
